trigger: run only after the vendor's calibration last_update is NEWER than the r3 one (2026-11-02 19:20:09+01:00); the live value before E and after F is recorded
circuit: H on every qubit, measure every qubit into c[i]; optimization_level 0; initial layout = identity; E and F submitted back to back
packing: per shot c0..c(n-1), c0 = rightmost char; shots concatenated in returned order; MSB-first; partial byte dropped

channel_rule.basis: r2 floor 0.622 (expected 0.87 within one calibration minus 0.25); z gate from the 3 November counterexample (same calibration mean |z| 0.76-0.92)

chosen: BEFORE the run: the four earlier runs as four priors of increasing age; each goes through the validated gate on E, none is picked by fit

software.where: tools/qrng of the public repo (with the compatibility z gate of 3 November)

K-S1.claim: known state: max over {r0, r1, r2AB, r3CD} of r(E, ref) >= 0.622
K-S1.basis: three recalibrations seen, every one landed in a state already seen

K-S2.claim: the latest state persists: r(E, r3CD) >= 0.622
K-S2.basis: r2->r3 returned to the same state; r0/r2/r3 are one state, r1 the other

K-V.claim: validated gate decision per prior on E
K-V.basis: dry runs on r3C above (P1 stand-in = r2AB)

K-V5.claim: every used prior: h_acc_val >= h_acc_none, out_val >= out_none, coverage of F >= cov_min

K-V6.claim: among used priors the gain does not grow with age: gain(P1) >= gain(P2) >= gain(P3)

scoring: K-S3, K-V5 are scored only if last_update is the same before E and after F (otherwise UNMEASURED). K-V1..4 = the gate decision per prior equals the prediction. K-V6 is scored over the priors actually used. Nothing is re-scored after the data.
interpretation: Q1: a third state would refute K-S1 (and K-S2); a return to the r1 state would refute K-S2 only. Q2: how far back a validated prior reaches, and whether its value decays with age. Statistics still cannot certify quantumness; receipts say 'statistical'.
